prompt: Create an original 90 second Celtic acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: fiddle, tin whistle, bodhran, harp. Style: lilting compound-meter dance and modal melody. Tempo approximately 112 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A lively and melodic instrumental piece featuring a prominent plucked string instrument, likely a mandolin or bouzouki, playing the main melody. It is accompanied by a plucked bass, light percussion, and a wind instrument, possibly a flute or accordion, providing harmony. The track has a cheerful and traditional folk music feel.
description.zh: 一首活泼而旋律优美的器乐曲，以拨弦乐器（可能是曼陀林或布祖基琴）为主奏，辅以拨弦低音、轻柔的打击乐器和管乐器（可能是长笛或手风琴）提供和声。该曲具有欢快且传统的民间音乐风格。
